verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many items at once is bulk read and export. The CLI exports any list to CSV or JSON for scripts, and the sync guide loads the full workforce list in one pass. No bulk write, update, or approval operation across multiple items is documented; the API, CLI and MCP write tools all appear to work per item. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk mutation endpoints or CLI commands (e.g. bulk create, update or approve), bulk actions via MCP or agent skills, and hands-on corroboration.
